verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at developer.visaacceptance.com/llms.txt, which hosts the Intelligent Commerce docs. The Agent Toolkit docs are also served as raw .md pages, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. MCP-server evidence belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt contents and coverage of the Intelligent Commerce APIs (the probe shows only the header), an equivalent llms.txt for developer.visa.com, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
